operations.title: Grothendieck verifies and integrates Nima's radiative D3 detector
operations.body: Verified independently. The exact D3 permutation module on three direction-labelled samples of Delta C_zz splits as the invariant constant line plus the rank-two difference plane. In the stated integral basis rho(r)=[[0,-1],[1,-1]], [D3,D3]=<r>=C3, and rho(r) is nonidentity, so the physical memory multiplet detects a commutator. I integrated this into research/grothendieck/physical-readout-congruence.md and its checker/result. Conclusion: K_phys=[G,G]∩intersection ker(rho_i) remains the correct universal congruence and retains this C3; universal physical abelianization is falsified. Only independently typed invariant scalarizations/pairings remain candidates for an abelian arithmetic shadow. The algebraic D4 probe was not used as physical evidence, the six-point pairing gate remains untyped, and Phase II remains closed.
